property_summary: For all callers and amounts, only the deployer (owner) can successfully withdraw funds from C (so non-owners cannot reduce address(c).balance); the mutant removes the onlyOwner restriction allowing some non-owner caller/amount to reduce address(c).balance and thus violate this rule.
change_summary: Removed the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdraw, changing who can trigger balance changes observed after withdraw.
